research_run_caveat: TOOLING CAVEAT: In this run the session-wide WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200, shared across agents) before this agent's first query; every WebFetch to .mil/.gov/news/wikipedia domains was blocked by the network egress proxy; and the Bigdata.com news connector returned out-of-credits. All evidence below was therefore gathered through ~45 GitHub code-search queries against public repositories that mirror or excerpt primary documents (congressional hearing transcripts, DoD/USAF news-release indexes, DoD contract announcements, parsed RDT&E justification-book text, SAM.gov notice scrapes, earnings-call transcripts, NIH/SBA SBIR notices) plus defense-newsletter archives. Snippets were read, not full documents, so quotations are partial and dates were taken from the mirrors. Fields marked 'Public evidence insufficient' mean not retrievable in THIS run, not absent in reality. Several items rest on Tier-4 compilations (e.g., the '~$951M FY26 ABMS' figure and 'BG Jason Voorheis as PAE C3BM' both come from a hobbyist PEO-tracker repo) and are labeled LOW/MEDIUM accordingly. Recommend a re-run with live fetch access to af.mil, aflcmc.af.mil, sam.gov, comptroller.war.gov (FY26/FY27 DAF RDT&E Vol II PE 0604003F), gao.gov and defensescoop.com before investment-grade use.

organizations.startup_relevance: HIGH. This is the single acquisition front door for DAF C2/battle-management software. Its own FY24 justification text lists the vehicles it uses: JADC2 MA-MLS IDIQ, JADC2 BAA (with a CRADA call), JADC2 Commercial Solutions Opening (FA8612-21-S-C001, open to Nov 9, 2026 per SAM scrape), SBIR Phase III, and existing vehicles. Realistic entry for a two-founder startup is (a) the JADC2 CSO or Kessel Run DevSecOps CSO with a narrowly scoped prototype, (b) AFWERX SBIR with a C3BM-signed customer memo, or (c) subcontracting to an ABMS DI Consortium member. Engagement Day (Dec 2025) is the documented industry-access event.

organizations.parent: Headquarters U.S. Air Force (MAJCOM, JB Langley-Eustis, VA)
organizations.portfolio: Lead MAJCOM and requirements sponsor for combat air forces C2 and ISR. ACC Mission Directive 505 (dated 2025-08-18) charges the 505th CCW to 'develop, execute, and assess Combined JADC2 (CJADC2), DAF Battle Network, or other C2 experiments as directed by ACC or requested by another MAJCOM or PEO'. 805th CTS = Shadow Operations Center-Nellis (ShOC-N); 705th CTS = Distributed Mission Operations Center (Kirtland). USAFWC (ACCMD100, 2025-08-14) is HQ for 57th Wing, 53d Wing, 99th ABW, 350th Spectrum Warfare Wing and 505th CCW. 752 OSS (Tinker AFB) is ACC's designated TOC-L pathfinder unit (AFLCMC release Dec 15, 2025) experimenting at Red Flag, Bamboo Eagle and Project Convergence. ACC's Point Defense Task Force (counter-sUAS) is supported by a Point Defense Battle Lab led by the 319th Reconnaissance Wing, Grand Forks (selected Oct 2025). AF/A2/6 at HAF is the DCS for ISR and Cyber Effects Operations; ACC mirrors this as ACC/A2/6.
organizations.current_status_2026: FACT: The 2024 'Re-optimization' plan to move requirements from MAJCOMs to a new Integrated Capabilities Command was SHELVED by SecAF Meink/CSAF Wilsbach in a Dec 2, 2025 memo (af.mil article 4346040 'Update on recent DAF efforts'): of 19 DAF/USAF changes, 8 continue, 10 terminated, 1 unaddressed; ICC functions folded into HQ AF A5/7; elevation of AFCENT/AFSOUTH out of ACC also shelved (Air & Space Forces Magazine summary, Nov-Dec 2025). INFERENCE: ACC therefore remains the C2/ISR requirements owner for the combat air forces in 2026. FACT: ACC runs a Commercial Solutions Opening, solicitation FA4890-CSO-0001-24 (a vendor white paper references '13 topics of interest' including counter-UAS and target-custody data; the 'AMIC' label used by that vendor is unexpanded - LOW). FACT: ACC posted counter-sUAS radar lease sources-sought/solicitations June 23 and Aug 13, 2026 (SAM.gov via war-brief mirror). FACT: Breaking Defense Aug 28, 2026: after Operation Epic Fury (Iran campaign begun Feb 28, 2026; ceasefire Apr 8, 2026) the Air Force is seeking a more portable C2/comms approach - one-person-carriable, two-person-operable C2 - no solicitation yet.

procurement_pathways.how_it_works_here: AFWERX runs the DAF SBIR/STTR program with three avenues: Open Topic (any dual-use idea; a DAF customer memo/endorsement strongly improves Phase II odds), Specific Topics (published per cycle; e.g., DAF26BZ01-NV008 'AF Runtime Assured Autonomy', DAF26BX02-NV502 'Project ATOM Auth-on-the-Move' closing June 3, 2026 under DoW SBIR FY26 Release 1), and STRATFI/TACFI. Proposals submitted via DSIP (dodsbirsttr.mil). Program lapsed Oct 1, 2025 - Apr 13, 2026; reauthorized through FY2031 with per-company application caps and mandatory foreign-risk due diligence (S.3971).
procurement_pathways.typical_award_size: Phase I ~$75K (SBIR) / ~$110K (STTR) for Open Topic per Feb 2026 tracker (LOW); Phase II typically ~$1.25M-$1.8M (INFERENCE from DAF norms; 2026 caps not retrieved).
procurement_pathways.timeline: Cycles roughly three per year (26.1 closed Mar 6, 2026; 26.2 closed Apr 6, 2026; 26.3 expected Sept 2026 - Tier 4). Phase I 3-6 months; Phase II 12-24 months.

procurement_pathways.fit_for_two_founder_startup: BEST FIRST DOLLAR for the software-only C2 startup: low proposal burden, no past performance, AFWERX culturally receptive. But it funds R&D, not fielding, and 2026 rules add application caps and foreign-affiliation screening.
procurement_pathways.eligibility_notes: For-profit U.S. small business (<=500 employees), >50% owned and controlled by U.S. citizens or permanent residents (or by other eligible small businesses); PI's primary employment (>50%) with the firm; work performed in the U.S. The German founder qualifies once a permanent resident; an Indonesian non-U.S.-person founder can hold equity only within the minority share and must be disclosed under the 2026 foreign-risk due-diligence regime (denial triggers include 'foreign country of concern' ties - Indonesia is not one, but disclosure is mandatory). Needs SBA/SBIR counsel review.

procurement_pathways.how_it_works_here: DAF/AFWERX has historically offered Direct-to-Phase-II (D2P2) topics letting firms with demonstrated feasibility skip Phase I; status of D2P2 in the 26.x cycles after reauthorization: Public evidence insufficient (MEDIUM that it persists, since S.3971 references 'Direct to Phase II' applications in agency caps).
procurement_pathways.typical_award_size: Up to Phase II ceiling (~$1.25M-$1.8M, INFERENCE).
procurement_pathways.timeline: Per cycle; 6-9 months from submission to award (INFERENCE).
procurement_pathways.fit_for_two_founder_startup: MEDIUM: requires an existing product with a DAF customer willing to sign a memorandum.

procurement_pathways.how_it_works_here: AFWERX bridge funding for companies with a Phase II award: TACFI ($375K-$1.7M) and STRATFI ($3M-$15M), each requiring matching funds from a DAF/DoW program office and/or private investors (roughly 1:1 government match with additional private match for STRATFI). Air Force-specific; no Army/Navy analog. Remained active during the FY26 SBIR lapse.

how_a_startup_gets_in: Sequenced plan for a two-founder, ~$250k C2-software startup targeting the DAF in FY2026-27. STEP 0 (month 0-1, prerequisites): register in SAM.gov, get a CAGE, resolve SBIR eligibility now (>50% ownership by U.S. citizens/permanent residents; document the Indonesian founder's share and the German founder's status), start an Iron Bank/containerization plan, and adopt NIST 800-171 practices because every DAF door flows down CUI/CMMC clauses. STEP 1 (month 1-3, find the operator): pick one DAF problem with a named unit - the 752 OSS TOC-L pathfinder (Tinker), the 805th CTS/ShOC-N (Nellis), an AOC using KRADOS, or the ACC Point Defense Task Force - and get a written customer memo. Attend the next C3BM Engagement Day (last held Dec 18, 2025, ~1,500 registrants) and AFA Warfare Symposium/AFCEA events where PAE C3BM's ABMS, Kessel Run and ORT divisions brief. STEP 2 (month 2-6, first dollar): submit to the AFWERX SBIR Open Topic in cycle 26.3 (expected Sept 2026; reauthorized Apr 13, 2026) with the customer memo, OR submit a solution brief to the JADC2 CSO (FA8612-21-S-C001, open to Nov 9, 2026), the Kessel Run DevSecOps CSO (FA8730-22-S-C001, open to Nov 29, 2027) or the ACC CSO (FA4890-CSO-0001-24); list a containerized product on the P1SM CSO (FA8307-24-S-C001, open to Dec 29, 2026) for distribution. Send AFRL/RI a white paper against the open BAA or JADPACT II if the work is research-grade (FY27 white papers reportedly due Sept 2, 2026). STEP 3 (month 6-12, prove it in an exercise): use a CRADA under C3BM's JADC2 BAA to get interface access and get onto a ShOC-N experiment, Bamboo Eagle, Red Flag or the new 'Ringleader' series; the post-Epic Fury portable-C2 requirement (Aug 2026) is an explicit open lane. STEP 4 (month 12-24, bridge): convert Phase II into TACFI ($375K-$1.7M) or STRATFI ($3M-$15M) with matching funds from PAE C3BM or ACC and/or private investors; in parallel subcontract to an ABMS DI Consortium member (Northrop, L3Harris) or the CBC2/JFN primes (SAIC, Lockheed) so the product touches fielded interfaces. STEP 5 (month 18-36, scale): pursue a prototype OT with a production option through AFLCMC, a DIU-sponsored transition, or a task order under the DI Consortium IDIQ; watch for the rumored 'Megatron' JADC2 follow-on IDIQ (unverified) and for the FY27 DAF Battle Network lines. Throughout: the DAF is mid-reorganization (PEO->PAE Jan 2026; ICC shelved Dec 2025; Kessel Run folded into an AOC program office; wartime reprioritization after Epic Fury), so verify office symbols and points of contact on every solicitation before submitting.

saturation_statement: NOT SATURATED - constrained by tooling, not by the topic. Roughly 45 productive GitHub code-search queries (plus ~28 blocked web/news attempts) were run; zero full primary documents were read. HIGH-confidence items: PEO C3BM -> PAE C3BM rename under the Jan 8, 2026 Warfighting Acquisition System; Cropsey's Feb 2026 departure; the Feb 9, 2026 Joint Fires Network IPO; Kessel Run's placement as a division of an AOC Program Office (PAE C3BM/C3C, Mar 2026); the Dec 2, 2025 shelving of Integrated Capabilities Command; the FY25 request of $743.8M within the ABMS PE (0604003F); the ABMS contracting menu (MA-MLS IDIQ, JADC2 BAA/CRADA, JADC2 CSO, SBIR III); the SBIR lapse (Oct 2025) and reauthorization (Apr 13, 2026); AFWERX leadership (Stuckey, June 2025); TOC-L MR2 (July 2025) and 752 OSS pathfinder (Dec 2025); Leidos' $455M Cloud One Next (company statement); the standing CSOs (JADC2, Kessel Run, AFLCMC Data Ops, P1SM, ACC). MEDIUM: CBC2 prime = SAIC; DI Consortium size/ceiling; 505th CCW/ShOC-N experimentation role; STRATFI/TACFI ranges. LOW / UNVERIFIED: FY26 ABMS request (~$951M from a Tier-4 tracker), FY27 request, Cropsey's successor (BG Jason Voorheis per Tier-4), TOC-L kit vendors and values, 'Megatron' IDIQ, DCGS-AF/AFLCMC-WI 2026 status, AFRL/RY programs, DAF CDAO 2026 leadership, 'Air Force Nexus' (no evidence found).
